about_the_game:
In the first days of the Fourth Age, a Dwarf travelling the high mountain passes came across a curious sight. It was a small pioneer grove of birch trees far above the tree line. To his surprise the tallest of the birches spoke to him. This lonely Ent was in fact one of the eldest of his kin, the great Skinbark.

His flock of trees suffered greatly at the hands of Saruman’s orcs and in his grief he fled with cuttings and seedlings high away from the war. It was here, in the mountains, that he regrew the trees he shepherded.

Taken by the sad story of Skinbark, the Dwarf stayed to keep his new friend company and to learn all he could from him. In this way at least one Ent learned the Axes of the Dwarves are for war and not felling the trees, as it has been since the first age that these two kin had quarrels.

When the Dwarf’s travels took him to back to his own kind he taught what he had learned. In the Dwarven fashion they adopted this new knowledge into what they began to call Ent-craft.

Through Ent-craft, cuttings may be harvested using the Berêk Rune, enscribed with Emeralds. Entwood may be harvested from the Wellingspring.

What's included:

  • Skinbark Cosmetic Skin

  • Ent-craft Shield

  • Ironbough Greatsword

  • Wellingspring Construction Recipe

  • Tree Planter Construction Recipes

  • Vine Trellis Construction Recipes

  • Hanging Basket Construction Recipes

  • Fangorn Draught Brew Recipe
